items.subject: Class Teacher (Special Needs) | Amer AlSaaideh
items.htmlBody:
Dear Dubai Center for Special Needs Hiring Team,

I am Amer Abdeljalil, a special education teacher with an MA in Special Education (Excellent) and over five years as a resource room teacher and inclusive education coordinator in Jordanian Ministry of Education schools. I also worked in Qatar as a special education specialist. DCSN serves people of determination of all ages, with primary, adult education, pre-vocational and multi-sensory sections.

  • Managed the IEP and instructional plan for each student, built on formal and informal assessments.
  • Delivered training at Al-Mubtakiroun for Counseling and Rehabilitation in behaviour modification, autism teacher preparation and shadow teacher preparation.

I am applying for the Class Teacher (Special Needs) position listed on your careers page. My CV is attached, and I am available for an interview at any time.

Kind regards,

Amer Abdeljalil AlSaaideh
Special Education Specialist | Inclusive Education Coordinator
MA in Special Education (Excellent) | 5+ years in Jordan and Qatar
Phone / WhatsApp+962 78 018 9766
Emailamer.abdeljalil77@gmail.com
LinkedInView my LinkedIn profile
Available immediately | Open to relocation
